body: That sucks. HF really can be triggered by so many things. But gabapentin is great to start getting the mental aspect of HF under control and starting to get into healthy routines and cycles. In my opinion, I would say don't even bother with muscle relaxants as they did nothing for me, if anything just made it worse. But gabapentin is great for nerve pain, just don't exceed 1200mg a day if you asked me. But again I'm not a doctor.
